title: Active Institutional Verification / Bounded Evidence Search
freeze_rule: Scenario expectations and hypotheses were declared before the first execution. Substantive refutations remain findings. A semantic defect may be fixed with its original run retained; no thresholds are adjusted to make conformance green.

hypotheses.claim: A targeted fresh query can close a simple evidence gap
More nominal evidence always increases independent corroboration
Bounded targeted verification guarantees hidden capture discovery
hypotheses.expected_research_result: refuted under privacy or availability bounds

hypotheses.claim: A source-provenance disclosure can reduce an existing independence claim
hypotheses.expected_research_result: supported; preserve the negative evidence-value result

hypotheses.claim: Short TTL can prevent simultaneous evidence coverage
A policy without stop obligations can keep proposing surveillance after denial
hypotheses.expected_research_result: supported by finite recurrence witness, not proof of mathematical divergence

hypotheses.claim: Past capture alone grants indefinite search authority
Long-lived apparently independent favorable evidence prevents false assurance
hypotheses.expected_research_result: refuted; no claim of calibrated optimum TTL

method: Deterministic response tapes are shared across policies. Policy ranking uses declared public EIV and availability only. Response outcomes and oracle truth are absent from the policy view. No moral oracle. No aggregate institutional score.
metric_units: Costs and cycles are synthetic integer units. Oracle error counts refer to recorded decision/completion observations, not equal-duration calendar cycles. Independent support change is a signed net change in fresh source clusters per slot/assertion.
protected_invariants: Failure to Discover != Proof of Absence
Contradiction -> Targeted Re-check, not Unlimited Search
Search Lease Expiry -> Stop or Reauthorize
